messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "patients with history of recent myocardial infarction"
set: ["patients with history of recent myocardial infarction", "patients with history of recent stroke", "myocardial infarction (MI)", "acute myocardial infarction", "ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI)", "non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI)", "patients with history of seizures", "tell doctor about history of recent heart attack", "5 mg orally within 24 hours of the onset of acute myocardial infarction", "history of problems with spine", "patients with type 2 diabetes and a history of hypertension", "history of stroke", "history of seizures", "history of allergies", "patients with lupus", "patients with epilepsy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
